figures.finding: Åland has no collective agreement of its own setting a screenwriter's pay: under the Autonomy Act (§ 27) labour law is the Finnish state's competence (except civil-service collective agreements for Åland's and its municipalities' employees), so engagement terms for a screenwriter follow Finland's.

tried.web-search: 2026-11-04: WebSearch 1 of 10 (the same search as the producer blocker's): 'Åland teater dramatiker arvode avtal …' (No Åland playwright agreement or fee; Swedish agreements (Svensk Scenkonst's dramatikeravtal and förlagsavtal) surfaced, which bind Swedish theatres, not Åland's.)
tried.institution: 2026-11-04: suomenteatterit.fi (Suomen Teatterit ry, the Finnish theatre employers): Työehtosopimukset, Käyttökorvaussopimukset page (files/m16/ax-st-kk.html), the recommended tariffs 'Suositusmäärät, näytelmät alle 2 h' and 'yli 2 h' (2012; files/m16/ax-sunklo2012-alle.pdf, -yli.pdf), the model commission contract 'Näytelmän tilaussopimus 2010', and the member list /jasenteatterit/; sunklo.fi (the playwrights' union, Suomen Näytelmäkirjailijat ja Käsikirjoittajat) home, twice (Found in part: Suomen Teatterit and the playwrights' union hold a recommended (not generally binding) agreement on domestic plays' royalties, a per-performance fee by stage size; the commission fee is a multiple of it. No Åland theatre is in Suomen Teatterit's member list (78 theatre names, none on Åland). sunklo.fi answered 429 Too Many Requests both times.)
tried.official-register: 2026-11-04: Självstyrelselag (1991:71) för Åland, 27 § (Rikets lagstiftningsbehörighet), in Ålands lagsamling 2024 part A (files/m16/ax-lagsamling-a.pdf) (Read: 27 § 10 'upphovsrätt' and 27 § 21 'arbetsrätt med undantag av tjänstekollektivavtal för landskapets och kommunernas anställda' are the Realm's, so a playwright's fee and royalty in Åland stand on Finnish copyright and labour law and Finnish agreements.)
